name: 48067 · Royal Oak, MI
findings: ZIP 48067 (Royal Oak) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48067 (Royal Oak) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48067 (Royal Oak) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
